sources.name: GitHub issues of chakra-ui/chakra-ui
sources.version: GitHub REST API 2022-11-28, state as of 2026-11-11
sources.license: GitHub Terms of Service (user content; only facts and our own summaries are kept)

provenance.notes: URL, number, title, state, dates, counts and labels are copied from the API response of each issue. Category, components, summary, resolution and lesson are written by the researcher (tools/extract/field-reports/curation) after reading the issue body returned by the search API and, for the issues listed in docs/research/field-reports.md, the full thread. daysOpen of an open issue is measured to the retrieval date. fixedBy is filled mechanically from merged pull requests that name the issue after a closing keyword. Reports marked needs-review state a cause that the researcher inferred from the symptom without a confirming statement in the issue.

reports.title: Request to add RTL support
reports.summary: A user needing RTL asked whether it was planned and how to help; the library had no RTL support and the request stayed open for ten months until logical style props arrived.
reports.lesson: RTL is present from the first release, so that no early adopter builds on physical props that later have to be migrated.

reports.title: Switch and NumberInput don't look any good in RTL
reports.summary: In RTL the switch thumb travelled outside its track when toggled and the number input's stepper buttons were laid out wrongly.
reports.lesson: Thumb travel and stepper placement use logical alignment; fixture: thumb rect stays inside the track rect in RTL for both states.

reports.title: Select icon should be at the inline-end for RTL
reports.summary: The native select's dropdown icon stayed on the right in RTL, overlapping the start of the text, because it was absolutely positioned with a physical right inset.
reports.lesson: Field indicators are positioned with inset-inline-end; no physical inset appears in field recipes.

reports.title: RTL broken for InputLeftElement/InputRightElement
reports.summary: With dir="rtl" on the html element, input left/right elements stayed on their physical sides while the input's padding followed direction, so adornments covered the text.
reports.lesson: Adornment slots are start/end, and the padding reserved for them uses the same logical side; names with left/right are not offered for direction-following slots.

reports.title: Add RTL Support for ButtonGroup
reports.summary: In an attached button group the rounded outer corners and squared inner corners were swapped in RTL, because the radii were removed with physical corner properties on first and last child.
reports.lesson: Attached groups use logical corner radii (start-start, end-end …); fixture: outer corners of an attached group are rounded in RTL.

reports.title: TabIndicator does not work in RTL
reports.summary: After switching from LTR to RTL the tab indicator stayed at its old position, since it was positioned from a measured left offset that was not recomputed for the new direction.
reports.lesson: Measured indicator geometry is recomputed when direction changes (direction is a dependency of the measurement), and is stored relative to inline-start.

reports.title: AbsoluteCenter has issues with RTL direction
reports.summary: In an RTL parent the absolute-centre helper did not centre its child: it combined a logical inline inset of 50% with a physical translate of -50%, which moves the element the wrong way in RTL.

fixedBy.title: fix absolute-center when parent is rtl

reports.lesson: Centring never mixes a logical inset with a physical translate; use inset: 0 with margin auto or place-items, or multiply the translate by the direction sign.

reports.title: Document `dir` should be used as the default dir in zag components' context
reports.summary: On a page with dir="rtl" some components, tabs among them, behaved as LTR unless a locale provider was added, because the underlying state machines default their direction to ltr.
reports.lesson: The DOM direction is the default; a provider is needed only to override it.

reports.title: Breadcrumb separator has issues in rtl pages
reports.summary: On an RTL page the breadcrumb's chevron separator pointed right, i.e. backwards.

fixedBy.title: fix: improve rtl support for breadcrumb

reports.lesson: Chevron separators are mirrored via the icon mirroring registry; the breadcrumb is an RTL screenshot fixture.

reports.title: Improve RTL support for half-highlighted RatingGroup.ItemIndicator
reports.summary: With half ratings in RTL the half-filled star was highlighted on the wrong half.
reports.lesson: Partial fills are clipped from the inline-start edge; fixture: value 3.5 in RTL fills the right half of the fourth star.

reports.title: Improve RTL support for Select.IndicatorGroup
reports.summary: In RTL the select's indicator group (clear button, chevron) was misaligned inside the trigger.
reports.lesson: Trigger internals are laid out with logical insets and gaps only.

reports.title: Incorrect display of arrowTip for HoverCard in RTL pages
reports.summary: On RTL pages the arrow tip of the hover card showed its border on the wrong edges, because the arrow is a rotated square styled with logical border sides: the logical side flips with direction while the rotation does not.
reports.lesson: Logical properties are wrong for geometry that is physical by construction: rotated arrows, shadows with offsets and anything positioned by measured coordinates use physical properties, exempted explicitly from the lint.
